name: monster.cad/converter
title: CAD Monster
description: CAD and 3D file conversion: check what cad.monster does with a format pair, get the order link.

tools.name: check_conversion
tools.description: Ask what cad.monster does with a conversion of a CAD or 3D model file: automatic, done by an engineer after a free estimate, or not offered. Returns the link to the order form to give to the person, and the free limits, timing and prices when the conversion is automatic. Creates nothing: no order is placed, no file is sent.

from.description: Extension of the person's file, for example "stl" or "CATPart".

to.description: Target: an extension ("step") or the name of a program ("solidworks", "3ds max"). Leave out to list every target offered for this source.

size_mb.description: Size of the person's files together, in MB. With it the answer names the cheapest option for an automatic conversion of that size.

tools.name: how_to_send_file
tools.description: Explain how to send the person's file to cad.monster: an HTTP upload outside MCP that answers with a one-time link opening the order form with the file in place. Gives the exact call, the limits and the fallback link for the person when the upload fails or your tools cannot reach the internet. This tool sends nothing itself. Use it after check_conversion, when the person asked to send the file.

to.description: Target extension: "upload_to" of the check_conversion answer, for example "step".
